what: OPERATOR DECISION + TERMS READ NEEDED before any design: should the phone executor ever read the login EMAIL and tap the number-match itself? Breakout's new terminal signs in by email: the page shows a few numbers and the user taps the matching number in an emailed message (observed by the operator 2026-10-05, build 1a.3 on the $20 account). Automating the email read and the number tap would defeat a human-verification step. PHONE-EXEC-1A has NOT designed or built it and will not without (a) an explicit operator decision and (b) a first-party read of Breakout's terms on automated access and verification. Until then the working assumption (design 7.9) is that every fresh login needs a human tap, so the go/no-go measure is how long a session lasts without re-auth (session.reauth_needed_after_min in the 1a.4 report) plus a re-login alert to the operator.
